p1_findings.observed: Approval checks do not enforce action/target matching, task/session identity, focus, expiry or budgets.
p1_findings.bounded_fix: Validate the exact permitted task, target/session, action and budgets at dispatch; enforce focus and expiry, fail closed on mismatch.

p1_findings.observed: Non-atomic acquisition/release races permit competing ownership and deletion of a reclaimed lease. Input does not validate lease ownership.
p1_findings.bounded_fix: Use atomic generation-token leases with fencing, validate ownership at input dispatch, and make release unable to remove a later generation.

p1_findings.observed: An effect followed by a lost reply remains pending; a synthetic takeover repeated the click.
p1_findings.bounded_fix: Use a durable action journal. Record dispatch and unresolved effects; block replay/takeover until uncertainty is reconciled against target state.
